nodes.name: deduct_inventory.php
nodes.summary: Standalone inventory-deduction helper that maps a package name to consumable/reusable item quantities, decrements stock on booking completion, and raises low-stock notifications. It is never `require`d or `include`d anywhere in the repository, so these two functions are currently unreachable dead code; the live equivalent is `deductInventoryOnComplete()` in `functions.php`.
nodes.languageNotes: Package-to-item mapping is hardcoded as a literal array keyed by the packages.name string, so renaming a package in the DB silently disables its deductions. Because the file has no require of functions.php, it depends on the caller having already loaded config.php/functions.php and passes the PDO handle in explicitly.

nodes.name: deductInventory
nodes.summary: Resolves the package name, looks it up in a hardcoded package-to-inventory map, decrements consumable stock via prepared statements, records reusable-item bookings, and notifies admin/staff when an item drops to its threshold. Returns a structured success/message/deducted/reusable/errors array and appends a line to `logs/inventory.log`.

nodes.name: recordReusableItemUsage
nodes.summary: Logs a reusable inventory item's usage against a booking by inserting a row into `booking_inventory` with the current timestamp.

nodes.name: index.php
nodes.summary: The single router and authenticated entry point for all SnapTrack UI (`index.php?page=<name>`). It loads config.php/functions.php, re-reads and re-validates the user from the DB on every request, validates the requested page against the per-role `$rolePages` allowlist, resolves the page file through a fallback chain (own role dir -> `pages/<page>.php` -> other role dirs -> shared `walkin.php` -> dashboard), then wraps it in header/sidebar/footer with the photography-themed topbar CSS.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely procedural PHP with no functions or classes: all control flow is top-level `if`/redirect/`require`. Two silent-failure behaviours matter here — a page missing from `$rolePages` is replaced with `dashboard` with no user-visible error (only `error_log`), and an unresolvable page file returns a hand-written 500 HTML page. Note it uses `session_start()` directly rather than `startSession()` from functions.php.

nodes.name: landing.php
nodes.summary: Public marketing landing page for STUDIO 94 self-shoot studio. Requires config.php/functions.php, branches its call-to-action links based on `isLoggedIn()` and session role (clients go to `index.php?page=booking`, staff/admin to `page=walkin`, anonymous users are sent through `login.php?redirect=...`), and embeds roughly 470 lines of inline CSS/HTML/JS for the hero, package tiers, and how-it-works sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Almost the entire file is inline `<style>` and markup rather than PHP — the only PHP is the 25-line auth-aware link computation at the top, so the file is mostly a static template with a dynamic header.

nodes.name: login.php
nodes.summary: Combined login / register / forgot-password / reset-password page that is the app's authentication entry point. A single CSRF-protected POST handler dispatches on a hidden `action` field: `login` (Gmail-only regex check, `password_verify`, refuses unverified email, `session_regenerate_id`), `register` (creates or refreshes an unverified client, sends a verification email and auto-verifies on 'skipped'/'failed' delivery), `forgot_password` (inserts a `password_resets` row and mails a link) and `reset_password` (consumes the token and rehashes the password).
nodes.languageNotes: Gmail-only policy is enforced twice — server-side via `preg_match('/@gmail\.com$/i')` and client-side via an HTML `pattern` attribute. The register branch silently auto-verifies the account when SMTP is unconfigured or blocked, so the email-verification gate is effectively bypassed on hosts without working mail.

nodes.name: logout.php
nodes.summary: Minimal session teardown endpoint that clears `$_SESSION`, expires the session cookie using the existing cookie params, destroys the session, and redirects to `login.php`. It requires only `functions.php` and relies on that file transitively loading `config.php` for the `APP_URL` constant.

nodes.name: mfa-helper.php
nodes.summary: Dependency-free TOTP (RFC 6238) implementation wrapped in the `MFAHelper` class — base32 secret generation/decoding, HOTP code derivation, constant-time verification with time-slice discrepancy tolerance, `otpauth://` URI building, QR code rendering via `endroid/qr-code`, and bcrypt-hashed single-use backup codes. Included only by `mfa-setup.php`.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-rolled TOTP so no Composer package is required: the base32 alphabet, HMAC-SHA1 truncation and dynamic-truncation bit extraction are all implemented inline with `hash_hmac` and `ord`. `getQRCodeDataURI()` falls back to the raw `otpauth://` URI when the optional `endroid/qr-code` classes are absent.

nodes.name: MFAHelper
nodes.summary: Static utility class holding the full TOTP two-factor flow: `generateSecret`, `base32Decode` (private), `generateCode`, `verifyCode`, `getOTPAuthURI`, `getQRCodeDataURI`, `generateBackupCodes`, `hashBackupCodes` and `verifyBackupCode`. No state is kept — every method is a pure function of its arguments.

nodes.name: base32Decode
nodes.summary: Private helper converting an RFC 4648 base32 TOTP secret into raw binary bytes, stripping padding/whitespace and packing leftover bits into a final character.

nodes.name: generateCode
nodes.summary: Derives a 6-digit HOTP code for a given time slice by HMAC-SHA1 hashing the 8-byte counter, applying dynamic truncation, and zero-padding the result.

nodes.name: verifyCode
nodes.summary: Validates a submitted 6-digit TOTP code against the secret, comparing the current and adjacent time slices with `hash_equals()` to tolerate modest device clock drift.

nodes.name: getQRCodeDataURI
nodes.summary: Renders the `otpauth://` provisioning URI as a base64 PNG data URI for inline `` display using endroid/qr-code, logging and degrading to the raw URI if the optional library is not installed.

nodes.name: verifyBackupCode
nodes.summary: Checks a user-supplied recovery code against the bcrypt hashes stored as a JSON array on the user row, and returns the rewritten hash list with the consumed code removed.

nodes.name: mfa-setup.php
nodes.summary: Standalone two-factor enrollment page that sits outside the router: a CSRF-protected POST handler supports `generate` (stash a new secret in the session and re-render the QR), `verify` (confirm the first TOTP code, persist `mfa_enabled`/`mfa_secret`/hashed backup codes, then show the codes once), and `disable` (requires re-entering the account password). Renders one of four states — backup codes, QR scan, enabled, disabled — depending on `?step=`, the pending session secret, and the stored `mfa_enabled` flag.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses POST-redirect-GET so the enrollment step is driven by `?step=` plus session state rather than by re-POSTing, and unsets `$_SESSION['new_backup_codes']` inline in the template so plaintext recovery codes are shown exactly once.

nodes.name: DFD.HTML
nodes.summary: Static 1800x1200 inline-SVG data-flow diagram titled 'Studio 94 DFD Layout' that maps the system's entities (Client, Studio Staff, Studio Owner), processes 1.0-8.0 (authentication, booking, service, inventory, AI chatbot, payment, feedback, reports) and data stores D1-D7. It contains no PHP and is dead: the `.HTML` extension means `index.php`'s router (which always appends `.php`) can never reach it, and nothing else links to it. Valuable only as design documentation of the intended system.
nodes.languageNotes: Hand-positioned SVG rects/text rather than a diagram DSL or Mermaid source, so the layout cannot be regenerated from a text definition — edits mean editing raw x/y coordinates.
